tools.name: db_databases
tools.description: The databases the person saved in Sikemux: name, engine, where it is, and whether you may change data in it.

tools.name: db_tables
tools.description: A saved database's schemas, and the tables and views in one of them.

database.description: A saved database's name, from db_databases.

schema.description: Default: public for PostgreSQL, main for SQLite.

tools.name: db_describe
tools.description: A table or view's columns with types, nullability and defaults, its primary key, indexes and foreign keys.

tools.name: db_query
tools.description: Run SQL on a saved database; statements separated by semicolons each return rows or a changed count. Read-only unless allowed.

limit.description: Rows kept from each statement. Default 100.
